violation_type.title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §746.305(a)(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not report unsafe conditions in a timely manner.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not report unsafe conditions in a timely manner.
During an investigation inspection, it was found, the operation did not report to childcare regulations an occurrence that rendered the facility unsafe.
The operation was having their fire alarm system installed and moved the children next door to the church without notifying CCR.
The operation did not report to licensing that a part of their building unsafe and unsanitary for children.
The facility failed to report an occurrence in which the health of staff, and children present was at risk.

Based on evidence gathered throughout the investigation, it was determined that the operation did not notify Child Care Regulations when the operation flooded with water; leaving their operation unsafe for the children.

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation did not report the incident to Child Care Licensing intake within the required 48 hours after the operation had an incident that was considered unsafe.

occurrences.facility_name: Kids 'R' Kids Learning Academy of West Frisco

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation had a gas leak in December 2026 and had to close the operation for one day because it was not safe for the children to remain in care until the gas leak was repaired. Also, in March 2026 one of the sprinkler head in the hallway broke and it caused a busted pipe and flooded one of the pre-K classroom causing the operation to close for a day because it was not safe for the children to remain in care until after the busted pipe was repaired.  The operation did not report either one of these incidents to licensing.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not notify licensing that there was mold growth in the building and that construction was going on rendering parts of the operation unsafe and unsanitary for children.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: Based on evidence gathered throughout the investigation, it was determined that the operation did not notify Child Care Regulations when the operation flooded with water; leaving their operation unsafe for the children.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: During an investigation inspection, it was found, the operation did not report an incident that happened at the operation in the front of staff and children which rendered the facility unsafe and placing children at risk.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: During an investigation inspection, it was found, the operation did not report to childcare regulations an occurrence that rendered the facility unsafe.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to show that Child Care Regulation was not informed of the scheduled power outage at the operation.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation failed to notify licensing of significant water damage and visible mold growth throughout the facility that created an unsafe and unsanitary environment.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: Based on information obtained during the course of the investigation, the operation failed to report the operation did not have running water to Child Care Regulation within 48 hours.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation's back building suffered major damage during a January 2026 winter storm that rendered the building unsafe for human occupation. The operation did not report this until late February of 2026. The operation has now permanently closed the building.

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: Director failed to report the infant classroom being unsafe due to water damages.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: I observe hazardous items in the two classrooms that are currently being remodeled. The classrooms are closed until repairs are completed.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and was found to be deficient. The operation did not make a self-report to Child Care Regulation when water from a leaky roof entered a room, when water entered another room through the back door/wall of the room, and when moisture was discovered in a wall of a room.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation had a leak from the ceiling on 04/30/2025 in one of the classroom and had to relocate the children into another classroom due to the leak causing the classroom to be unsafe and unsanitary. The operation did not noifty licensing.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: There was a flood in the center causing two of the rooms to be unsafe to care for children. This was not reported to licensing. One of the walls has a clear seal and the other one does not.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: It was determined throughout the course of the HHS Investigation that children in care were exposed to unsanitary conditions regarding plumbing concerns.  The unsanitary conditions started on 4/8/25.  CCR arrived at the facility to investigate on 4/11/25.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, the operation failed to inform Child Care Regulation within the mandated two-day period about the lack of running water.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: Operation Mustard Seed Academy failed to notify Child Care Regulation within the required two-day timeframe after receiving non-compliant lead test results.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: This standard was reviewed during a DFPS investigation and found deficient.  The operation did not notify CCR when they had to close due to a lack of running water and gas leak.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation had a pest outbreak that was not reported to CCR. The outbreak caused a class to move out of their classroom due to the unsanitary conditions.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation within two days of the incident.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: During the walkthrough a classroom became unsafe to use and licensing was not made aware at inspection.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The building was flooded during a major storm in April 2023, leading to the operation closing temporarily on April 28th, 2023 to pump the water out of the building and make repairs.  This unsafe facility occurrence was not reported to CCR staff appropriately within the required timeframe.

occurrences.finding: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation did not notify child care regulation of the lack of water in the building due water line/plumbing issues.

Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation did not notify closure.  On Monday July 18, 2022 the operation closed for several months to make repairs due to a rain storm.  The roof had to be replaced, building had to be rewired, new floors,  paint and equipment. The operation reopened on September 6, 2022,
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: During inspection on 09/15/22, several classrooms were closed due to mold in the building and this was not reported to Child Care Regulations.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: It was determined the operation did not notify Child Care Regulation of the air conditioner unit that stopped working, which effected 2 classrooms at the operation.
Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence: The operation did not report to Licensing a fire that took place on the premises.
